ideas.title: Pinchy's camera
ideas.critique: The viewpoint itself becoming a character with taste and clumsiness is a real twist on how the player sees the island, and it touches the camera rather than adding an event. It risks reading as one more camera shot mode plus a crab gag if the wobble and claw overlay are the only payoff.

ideas.title: Copycats
ideas.critique: Friends authoring wonky copies of Lumi's work, accumulating and never removed, reverses who makes the island and builds a second homemade layer. Needs several distinct junk objects each morning to avoid being a few props; the idea is the same as the round-1 night-mischief pitch in a stronger framing.

ideas.title: Wishes acted out
ideas.critique: Typed words turned into live charades is a fun, player-facing loop, but it is the wish box and a trigger/friends-react recipe, which the goals already point at. Success depends on how many words get distinct acts; otherwise it is a lookup table of emotes.

ideas.title: The island that swims
ideas.critique: A colossal living thing that approaches across sessions changes what the island is and gives the horizon a payoff, but it is nearly the same pitch as round 1's second island and shares the slow-arrival arc of Shell. The blink-and-wave finale is charming; the risk is a mesh on the horizon.

ideas.title: Behind the cottage window
ideas.critique: The first interior, lived in and seen through a window with Lumi asleep inside, adds a new kind of space and ties to the real sleep rhythm. It is quiet, and a window view is a static still unless the inhabitants do visible things there.

ideas.title: The tiny island on the stump
ideas.critique: A miniature civilisation found only by looking closely changes the scale of the island and rewards exploration, which nothing earlier does. Needs real life at tiny scale, not just a decorated stump, to be worth showing to a friend.

ideas.title: Mischief at night
ideas.critique: This is the round-1 pitch again, now with a scarecrow added; a reworded idea counts as the same. The friends-as-makers reversal is good but it is judged as before, and it overlaps strongly with Copycats.

ideas.title: A day in reverse
ideas.critique: Same idea as round 1: a whole-island time inversion that undoes itself, close to Rewind in shape. Bold in scope and funny with everyone acting normal, but a large amount of work and a familiar payoff.
